run_autoround_quantize_and_save: run AutoRound to quantize a model with 4-bit asymmetric grouping and save the output
test_autoround_torch_4bits_asym: test the torch backend with 4-bit asymmetric quantization using group size 128
test_autoround_torch_4bits_sym: test the torch backend with 4-bit symmetric quantization using group size 32
create_autoround_config: create an AutoRoundConfig with torch backend to load a quantized model from disk
evaluate_model_accuracy: evaluate the quantized model accuracy with a configurable threshold and batch size
